_comment: The approved skips (QA-007). scripts/ci/gate.mjs fails when a skip has no reason, when a file skips more tests than its 'max', or when a file not listed here skips at all. 'max' is the count on a clean checkout WITHOUT the customer material (git-ignored: SAMPLE PROJECTS/*, manual format/, the Arial Narrow files); with the material present the count is lower. Every entry says what is missing and where it is looked for. Counted from the skip sites on 2026-11-27 (WP-08); a full gate run on a clean runner confirms or lowers them. Growing a number needs a reviewed change to this file.

golden-xignal.test.js.why: the Xignal S1000D sample (SAMPLE PROJECTS/S1000D, customer material) or GOLDEN_SAMPLE_DIR

importer-repairs.test.js.why: the Vektra plugin output (SAMPLE PROJECTS/RWI or VEKTRA_SAMPLE)

importer-scan.test.js.why: the Xignal S1000D and JSS exports and the Vektra output (SAMPLE PROJECTS)

importer-structure.test.js.why: the Xignal S1000D export and its reference PDF (SAMPLE PROJECTS/S1000D)

jss-naval.test.js.why: the Naval Word stencils (manual format/NAval_stencil or NAVAL_STENCILS)

jss-rwi-verify.test.js.why: the RWI sample package (RWI_ZIP or SAMPLE PROJECTS/JSS-0251/RWI.zip)

jss-stencil-corrections.test.js.why: the JSS-0251 Word stencils (6 tests) and the licensed Arial Narrow font files (1 test)

pdf-reference.test.js.why: the 20 Nov sample publications and their reference PDFs (SAMPLE PROJECTS/S1000D/20_Nov _2026), one test per publication

deep-workspace.test.js.why: Windows-only path limit; skips on Linux/macOS runners

project-delete-after-build.test.js.why: Windows-only file locks; skips on Linux/macOS runners
